description: This file defines an interface 'ConfigurationInterface' within the 'Aws\Endpoint\UseFipsEndpoint' namespace. The interface specifies methods related to configuring and querying FIPS endpoint usage for AWS SDK endpoints.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for checking if FIPS endpoints are used and converting the configuration to an array.

methods.name: isUseFipsEndpoint
methods.description: Method to determine if FIPS endpoints are to be used.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Method to return the configuration as an associative array.
